situation.name: feynman_diagrams_adoption_sir
situation.description: SIR model for the spread of Feynman diagrams in physics communities. Susceptible physicists become adopters (infected) through contact, and eventually become recovered (no longer using the diagrams).

article.name: The power of a good idea: Quantitative modeling of the spread of ideas from epidemiological models
article.author: Bettencourt, L.M.A., Cintron-Arias, A., Kaiser, D.I., Castillo-Chavez, C.

data.name: feynman_diagrams_adoption_data
data.source: Physica A 364 (2006) 513-536, Google search query data

params.name: recruitment_rate
params.meaning: Recruitment rate of new physicists (people/year)

params.name: infection_rate
params.meaning: Per-capita S-I contact rate (1/year)

params.name: recovery_rate
params.meaning: Recovery rate (1/year), inverse of average idea lifetime

params.name: exit_rate
params.meaning: Exit rate from population (1/year), inverse of average career lifetime

params.name: basic_reproductive_number
params.meaning: Basic reproductive number R0 = beta/(g+m)

situation.name: feynman_diagrams_adoption_sei
situation.description: SEI model for the spread of Feynman diagrams with incubation period. Susceptible physicists first become exposed (incubators) before becoming adopters.
